keyInterpretation: GP Missile yield can be explored without automatic SPEN/APEN growth.
A simple Swarmer is mechanically plausible as early as TL1-TL2, but frozen small packets age out quickly.
A mature two-packet Swarmer regains a bounded TL6-TL7 niche through coverage and PDS saturation, then fades at TL8-TL9.
Automatic Kinetic accuracy is a clean smart-projectile maturation axis; raw Damage/APEN remain separate accelerator/projectile controls.
